tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient-lag signature support the documented coupled two-state memory ODE. Eight varied rows now permit numerical fitting of its four parameters; the model reconstructs the initial memory state from each raw prefix and integrates the forecast state with RK4.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing five observations plus three added rows provide eight varied rows, meeting the archive's stated minimum for the four-parameter coupled memory ODE.
All observed rows have s_grad=0 and the signatures specifically indicate history-dependent transient lag; branch/sink inhibition models do not explain the endpoint-matched history gap.
They omit the observed influence of the prior trajectory and coupled transient lag.
